description: Look up a celestial object by Messier number (e.g. M31), NGC/IC designation (e.g. NGC7000), or common name (e.g. Andromeda Galaxy). Optionally compute visibility from a given location and time.

date.description: Date/time in ISO 8601 format (defaults to now)

name.description: Object name, Messier number, NGC/IC designation, or common name

name: lookup_object
